verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own Connector Builder includes an AI Assistant that, when starting a new connector, automatically prefills and configures fields and sections. The resulting connector can be developed and used in syncs inside the Airbyte workspace, which supports a review-then-ship flow. However, the evidence never says the assistant works from API documentation, never says which sections it fills (auth, pagination, streams), and never shows the drafted connector actually working. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of drafting from API docs, documented coverage of auth, pagination and streams, a review and publish workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts a working connector from API documentation — auth, pagination, streams — that I review and ship
